DLC2310:4:t_002:6.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$バナージ・リンクス$$...」

DLC2310:4:t_002:8.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「You've got rotten luck, though. Trouble on your very first practical exercise after transferring here.」

DLC2310:4:t_002:10.en:
$$ミコット$$
「Are you okay? Do you feel sick?」

DLC2310:4:t_002:11.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I can't really explain it, but I feel something unpleasant all around me...」

DLC2310:4:t_002:12.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「Hey, come on! Don't try to scare us!」

DLC2310:4:t_002:13.en:
$$キラ$$
「The shuttle pilot contacted us! It sounds like a mobile suit unit is chasing them!」

DLC2310:4:t_003:1.en:
$$シン$$
「What are they doing deploying troops out here?!」

DLC2310:4:t_003:2.en:
$$キラ$$
「And some of those machines are types I've never seen before.」

DLC2310:4:t_003:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
（That strange presence I felt earlier... It's coming from that command unit...!）

DLC2310:4:t_003:5.en:
???
「It would be a problem if they caught on to our movements now, but we cannot let them see the $$ギラ・ドーガ$$, either. I'll leave this to you.」

DLC2310:4:t_004:1.en:
$$キラ$$
「But the remaining units are coming toward us...!」

DLC2310:4:t_004:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「It looks like that shuttle strayed off course and stumbled on an $$アクシズ$$ military operation.」

DLC2310:4:t_004:4.en:
$$シン$$
「What do you mean, what should we do?! If they're coming at us, we have to fight back!」

DLC2310:4:t_004:5.en:
$$キラ$$
「...All right. Our first priority is to get the shuttle to safety.」

DLC2310:4:t_005:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The shuttle's withdrawn! We'll cut off the pursuit here!」

DLC2310:4:t_006:1.en:
$$シン$$
「What is it this time, $$カミーユ$$?!」

DLC2310:4:t_007:1.en:
$$シン$$
「That new model that withdrew earlier is here, too!」

DLC2310:4:t_007:2.en:
$$ハマーン$$
（That man... So he himself withdrew.）

DLC2310:4:t_007:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
（One might call it a coolheaded decision, but soldiers won't follow a man like that... An imitation is all he is, after all.）

DLC2310:4:t_007:4.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「What is the meaning of this, $$ハマーン・カーン$$?!」

DLC2310:4:t_007:5.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Exactly what it looks like. We are resuming our activities.」

DLC2310:4:t_007:6.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「As a reborn $$ジオン$$... $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

DLC2310:4:t_007:8.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「We will issue our formal declaration another day. You simply had the privilege of hearing it first.」

DLC2310:4:t_007:9.en:
$$シン$$
「You...! Do you want another war?!」

DLC2310:4:t_007:10.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「This is the result of $$アースノイド$$ arrogance and their refusal to end the oppression of $$スペースノイド$$s.」

DLC2310:4:t_007:11.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ロゴス$$ and the $$ティターンズ$$ have fallen! The world is changing!」

DLC2310:4:t_007:12.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I wanted to believe that myself. But what does reality tell us?」

DLC2310:4:t_007:13.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Even behind the joint exercises by the $$新地球連邦軍$$, $$ザフト$$ and $$オーブ$$, I can sense the will of those who oppose the $$スペースノイド$$s.」

DLC2310:4:t_007:15.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Enough talk, $$カミーユ・ビダン$$. If you refuse to withdraw, I will crush you here.」

DLC2310:4:t_007:16.en:
$$シン$$
「What do we do, $$カミーユ$$?! Should we ask headquarters for reinforcements?!」

DLC2310:4:t_007:17.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The Minovsky particles are too dense! Long-range communication is impossible!」

DLC2310:4:t_007:19.en:
$$シン$$
「We're up against $$ハマーン・カーン$$!」

DLC2310:4:t_007:20.en:
$$キラ$$
「But if we stop her, we may be able to stop $$アクシズ$$... to stop $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

DLC2310:4:t_007:21.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Then... we have no choice.」

DLC2310:4:t_007:23.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ハマーン$$...! If you want a fight, we'll beat you right here!」

DLC2310:4:t_007:24.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Can you manage that with only three machines...?」

DLC2310:4:t_008:0.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「To think three machines could do this...!」

DLC2310:4:t_008:1.en:
$$シン$$
「Don't think we're just any three pilots! We fought our way through the $$多元戦争$$!」

DLC2310:4:t_008:2.en:
$$シン$$
「We fought through suffering and grief... through misunderstandings and regrets, all to win peace!」

DLC2310:4:t_008:5.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I'll silence that insolent mouth of yours!」

DLC2310:4:t_009:1.en:
$$キラ$$
「I'm all right. I didn't take that much damage.」

DLC2310:4:t_009:2.en:
$$シン$$
「Why would you do something so reckless?!」

DLC2310:4:t_009:3.en:
$$キラ$$
「Using the $$ドラグーン$$ has taught me a little about how guided weapons work...」

DLC2310:4:t_009:4.en:
$$シン$$
「That's not what I mean! Why did you protect me...?!」

DLC2310:4:t_009:9.en:
$$キラ$$
「...I'll put it into words properly.」

DLC2310:4:t_009:10.en:
$$キラ$$
「We're comrades fighting for the same goal.」

DLC2310:4:t_010:1.en:
$$キラ$$
「Whatever you might think of me, that's how I feel.」

DLC2310:4:t_010:5.en:
$$シン$$
「Because of our past, I couldn't say it properly before, but I feel the same way!」

DLC2310:4:t_010:6.en:
$$シン$$
「Whatever you might think of me, $$キラ$$, I'd already decided... I was going to fight alongside you!」

DLC2310:4:t_010:8.en:
$$シン$$
「Then please don't do anything reckless!」

review.context: The shuttle is rescued; Haman announces Neo Zeon's return. Kira shields Shinn and explicitly calls him a comrade, breaking their mutual reserve.
decisions: The withdrawing anonymous commander is described without revealing his name; Haman calls him an imitation.
Kira's unfinished because-we-are exchange remains unfinished across its matching rows.
